entities.name: Jean Baptiste Christophore Fusée Aublet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Baptiste Christophore Fusée Aublet was a French pharmacist, botanist and one of the earliest botanical explorers in South America. He was one of the first botanists to study ethnobotany in the Neotropics.
